        public MediaEncoder(

            IBlurayExaminer blurayExaminer,

        /// <summary>
        /// Run at startup to validate ffmpeg.
        /// Sets global variables FFmpegPath.
        /// Precedence is: CLI/Env var > Config > $PATH.
        /// </summary>
        /// <returns>bool indicates whether a valid ffmpeg is found.</returns>
        public bool SetFFmpegPath()
        {
            var skipValidation = _config.GetFFmpegSkipValidation();
            if (skipValidation)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("FFmpeg: Skipping FFmpeg Validation due to FFmpeg:novalidation set to true");
                return true;
            }

            // 1) Check if the --ffmpeg CLI switch has been given
            var ffmpegPath = _startupOptionFFmpegPath;
            string ffmpegPathSetMethodText = "command line or environment variable";
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(ffmpegPath))
            {
                // 2) Custom path stored in config/encoding xml file under tag <EncoderAppPath> should be used as a fallback
                ffmpegPath = _configurationManager.GetEncodingOptions().EncoderAppPath;
                ffmpegPathSetMethodText = "encoding.xml config file";
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(ffmpegPath))
                {
                    // 3) Check "ffmpeg"
                    ffmpegPath = "ffmpeg";
                    ffmpegPathSetMethodText = "system $PATH";
                }
            }

            if (!ValidatePath(ffmpegPath))
            {
                _ffmpegPath = null;
                _logger.LogError("FFmpeg: Unable to find ffmpeg in path. Please check your configuration and try again.");
                return false;
            }

            _ffmpegPath = ffmpegPath;
            _ffprobePath = Path.Combine(Path.GetDirectoryName(ffmpegPath), "ffprobe");

            if (!ValidatePath(_ffprobePath))
            {
                _logger.LogError("FFmpeg: Unable to find ffprobe in path. Please check your configuration and try again.");
                return false;
            }

            return true;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Validates the path to ffmpeg.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="path">The path to ffmpeg.</param>
        /// <returns>True if the path is valid, false otherwise.</returns>
        private bool ValidatePath(string path)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(path))
            {
                return false;
            }

            try
            {
                var process = new Process
                {
                    StartInfo =
                    {
                        FileName = path,
                        Arguments = "-version",
                        RedirectStandardOutput = true,
                        UseShellExecute = false,
                        CreateNoWindow = true
                    }
                };

                process.Start();
                process.WaitForExit();

                if (process.ExitCode != 0)
                {
                    return false;
                }

                return true;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Error validating ffmpeg path");
                return false;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Extracts video images on interval.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="inputFile">The input file.</param>
        /// <param name="options">The encoding options.</param>
        /// <param name="cancellationToken">The cancellation token.</param>
        /// <returns>A task that represents the asynchronous operation.</returns>
        public async Task<string> ExtractVideoImagesOnIntervalAsync(
            string inputFile,
            EncodingOptions options,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            if (options.HardwareAccelerationType == HardwareAccelerationType.videotoolbox && _isLowPriorityHwDecodeSupported)
            {
                // VideoToolbox supports low priority decoding, which is useful for trickplay
                var inputArg = "-hwaccel_flags +low_priority " + inputFile;
                var filterParam = GetVideoProcessingFilterParam(inputFile, options).Trim();
                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(filterParam))
                {
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("EncodingHelper returned empty or invalid filter parameters.");
                }

                try
                {
                    return await ExtractVideoImagesOnIntervalInternal(
                        (options.EnableKeyFrameOnlyExtraction ? "-skip_frame nokey " : string.Empty) + inputArg,
                        filterParam,
                        options.VideoEncoder,
                        options.Threads,
                        options.QualityScale,
                        options.Priority,
                        cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
                }
                catch (FfmpegException ex)
                {
                    if (!options.EnableKeyFrameOnlyExtraction)
                    {
                        throw;
                    }

                    _logger.LogWarning(ex, "I-frame trickplay extraction failed, will attempt standard way. Input: {InputFile}", inputFile);
                }

                return await ExtractVideoImagesOnIntervalInternal(inputFile, filterParam, options.VideoEncoder, options.Threads, options.QualityScale, options.Priority, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
            }

            // ... rest of the method remains the same ...
        }

using Xunit;
using Moq;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

namespace MediaBrowser.MediaEncoding.Encoder
{
    public class MediaEncoderTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task ExtractVideoImagesOnIntervalAsync_LogsWarningOnFfmpegException()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<MediaEncoder>>();
            var mediaEncoder = new MediaEncoder(loggerMock.Object, null, null, null, null, null, null);
            var inputFile = "inputFile";
            var options = new EncodingOptions
            {
                HardwareAccelerationType = HardwareAccelerationType.videotoolbox,
                EnableKeyFrameOnlyExtraction = true,
                VideoEncoder = "videoEncoder",
                Threads = 1,
                QualityScale = 1,
                Priority = ProcessPriorityClass.Normal
            };
            var cancellationToken = new CancellationToken();

            // Act
            await mediaEncoder.ExtractVideoImagesOnIntervalAsync(inputFile, options, cancellationToken);

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(logger => logger.LogWarning(It.IsAny<Exception>(), "I-frame trickplay extraction failed, will attempt standard way. Input: {InputFile}", inputFile), Times.Once);
        }
    }
}
